purpose.zh: 练腿后侧和臀部，学会以髋为轴发力
purpose.en: Build the hamstrings and glutes and learn the hip hinge.

text.zh: 臀部向后推，背部平直，哑铃贴腿下放
text.en: Push your hips back with a flat back and lower the weights close to your legs
Keep your knees soft without squatting.

text.zh: 腿后侧有拉伸感就停，再把髋向前推站直
text.en: Stop when your hamstrings stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
